explanation: I grepped Mathlib for contDiff_all_iff_nat and similar names. Besides the theorem itself, the only users and neighbours are contDiffOn_all_iff_nat and contDiff_infty. contDiffOn_all_iff_nat is the set version, and the theorem's own proof uses it. contDiff_infty says only that ContDiff ∞ is equivalent to ContDiff n for all natural n. Getting the theorem from it needs a case split on n : ℕ∞, which is more than a one- or two-line derivation. I found no declaration that states the same result.
